assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: side-on 2D fighting game arena background for Infernal Versus, stolas-palace. Adapt the reference image of Stolas' palace balcony from Helluva Boss into a single wide empty terrace background, intact before S2E12. Preserve the recognizable architectural design and palette: angular pale gray stone façade, mauve plum diamond-pattern glass door, narrow tall windows, gold arcane line ornament on the façade, square stone columns with feather motifs, balcony balustrade with elongated pointed openings and a central heart motif, rose-petal stone finials. Show enough palace façade on the left and rear and distant muted pink infernal sky with silhouetted rooftops on the right to read as an OUTDOOR TERRACE. Eye-level side-view fighting stage, open level stone floor across the entire bottom 27 percent, unbroken horizontal fighting line and ample open space for two characters. Architecture behind that line, no stairs on the fighting lane. Match Helluva Boss clean black line art, flat cel-shaded mauve-gray shapes and restrained atmospheric depth, high-detail 2D background. This is a gameplay adaptation of the terrace, do not redesign it into a generic fantasy castle or palace interior. Technical output: landscape 1536 x 1024, one complete environment only, opaque background. No people, no animals, no silhouettes of people, no lettering, no interface, no logos, no watermark, no split panels. Maintain readable low-contrast lower play area.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one midground parallax scenery prop for a 2D fighting game, Stolas palace terrace. The prop is one connected architectural object, front elevation with only slight visible depth, no dramatic perspective. All cutout openings must be genuinely transparent. Technical output: square 1024 x 1024, whole object centered, 8 percent margin on all sides, actual transparent background. No floor, no facade, no sky, no characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no separate objects, no drop shadow outside the object.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: side-on 2D fighting game arena background for Infernal Versus, bee-party.
